title: mesh-bus-core
description: Bus substrate types and plugin trait surface; runtime data types are imported from /schemas/ via mesh-bus-schema.

packet_id.description: Every Frame carries a packet_id derived from its sequence unless explicitly constructed otherwise.

flow_id.description: Every Frame carries a flow_id derived from session and target for router policy and queueing.

traffic_class.description: Every Frame has a traffic class for future queueing discipline.

flow_semantics.description: Every Frame declares generic L4 flow-shape metadata: ByteStream, Datagram, or Message.

return_semantics.description: Every Frame carries the return aggregation semantics selected for the dispatch path.

ttl_guard.description: The bus drops ttl=0 packets before scheduler ranking or egress dispatch.

ordered.description: Frames submitted by one SessionHandle are acknowledged one at a time before the next frame is dispatched.

flow_pinning.description: A flow is pinned to the first successful egress index and future frames in that flow prefer that egress.

close_releases_pin.description: Close and Cancel frames close the pinned egress session and remove the bus pin.

flow_id.description: Scheduler rank receives FlowId through RankContext.

traffic_class.description: Scheduler rank receives TrafficClass through RankContext.

deadline.description: Scheduler rank receives optional deadline_ms through RankContext.

policy_ref.description: Scheduler rank receives optional policy_ref through RankContext.

schedule_hint.description: Scheduler rank receives ScheduleHint through RankContext; runtime may also realize Datagram FanOut before calling the scheduler.

flow_semantics.description: Scheduler rank receives FlowSemantics through RankContext.

return_semantics.description: Scheduler rank receives ReturnSemantics through RankContext.

egress_append.description: Bus appends the selected ExitId to Frame.path_trace before egress send.

ordered.description: SchedulerPlugin can return an ordered candidate list for first-success dispatch.

replicate.description: SchedulerPlugin can return a replicate candidate list for multi-egress fan-out.

direct.description: Ordered byte-stream returns are emitted directly without packet_id dedup.

packet_id_dedup.description: Replicate and datagram return paths can record returned (flow_id, packet_id) pairs and suppress duplicate ReturnEvent emission.

sequence_reorder_reserved.description: Sequence reordering is reserved for future ByteStream + Striping dispatch, not for Ordered or Replicate.

first_success.description: Replicate dispatch emits the first successful egress return and continues collecting feedback from remaining replicas.
